text:
julia: Quick heads-up — kicking off a short sync to align on the SI bootcamp + partner lab kits. Goal: get our first 3 SIs through a 2-week onramp and have hardware/cloud lab parity.

owen: love it. can we lock dates before we draft content? Q2 timeline?

julia: aiming for week of May 12 (2 weeks). tentative until we confirm trainer availability.

mina: I can teach the runtime/ops module (day 4). need hardware kit checklist from infra.

dan: infra will provide 3 of the NGC-like dev kits + 2 CPU-only nodes. shipping ETA ~10 business days once we sign off on the BOM.

alex: tagging marketplace/legal — we also need approved partner logos and marketplace listing copy for the joint announcement. @partners-bot can you add marketplace checklist? :pray:

partners-bot: Added item: "marketplace listing + logo assets" to /partnerships/si-onboard-tracker. Link: https://redwood.example.com/partnerships/si-onboard-tracker

owen: for the bootcamp curriculum I propose 6 sessions: intro/platform, deployment patterns, tuning/quant, ops/tracing, security/compliance, hands-on lab + demo day. each session 90 min + 60 min lab. thoughts?

julia: that works. add a short pre-read and a validation checklist (we want an SI to do a live deploy and run a 500-req load test by demo day).

mina: +1. for validation let's define pass/fail rubrics: "can deploy in VPC, can pin model version, can show <200ms p50 on 256-token prompt (dedicated)" — is that realistic?

dan: p50 target depends on instance type, but for our recommended config it should be achievable. let's make targets per-kit and annotate them in the BOM.

alex: on announcements: prefer soft launch (no press) for first wave — a marketplace co-listing + joint case study after first SI finishes. we should prepare an email template and a one-pager.

julia: action items: 1) dan: finalize BOM & shipping timeline (due Fri) 2) mina: draft lab exercises + validation rubrics (due Wed) 3) owen: schedule bootcamp calendar and invite SIs (due Mon) 4) alex: assemble marketplace/legal checklist & announcement copy (due Thu)

owen: I'll create a calendar invite pool and a public sign-up sheet for SIs. link to signup once ready.

mina: quick Q — do we want a lightweight certification badge for SIs who pass demo day? maybe a "Redwood Integrator — Bootcamp" badge.

julia: yes, but keep it simple for MVP: email cert + GitHub badge + small markdown cert page. we can add gamified badging later.

partners-bot: Reminder set: "SI bootcamp planning check-in" on 1768190000 (in 2 days).

dan: attached example BOM snippet below:
```
- GPU Kit x3: 1x A100-80GB, 2x A10
- CPU Kit x2: 2x 32-core nodes
- Switch + cables
- USB hardware dongles for local secure keys (optional)
- Preloaded Docker images + sample datasets
```

alex: can we standardize a short troubleshooting cheat sheet for SIs (common errors, logs to check, who to ping)? I'll draft and post to the repo.

julia: good call. include escalation matrix (oncall eng, solutions eng, product). we need SLAs for dedicated vs hosted during labs.

owen: timeline notes: once BOM signed, we can book shipping + trainer slots. also recommending one dry run with internal SEs the week before demo day.

mina: will add lab exercise: "deploy a model, enable KV cache, run a 30-min load test, collect token cost metrics". will include expected dashboard screenshot snippets.

dan: FYI — hardware vendor asked for our packaging spec. I'll share the doc shortly.

julia: cool. next sync Tue 10am PT. if anyone is blocked on their action items ping here. thanks all :rocket:
